units.name: Bank0_ResetInitializeHardware
units.summary: Disable interrupts and decimal mode, initialize the stack, disable rendering and wait for two vertical blanks before clearing the APU registers and RAM.

units.name: Bank0_FinishApuAndClearRam
units.summary: Finish clearing APU register shadows, then clear zero page and stack RAM. Seed RAM00 with JMP opcode $4C so RAM01/02 can act as the bank-service trampoline.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeServiceAndDisplayState
units.summary: Install the RAM trampoline, initialize mapper/input/display state and compute the initial scene index. Synchronize display work before enabling the four APU channels.

units.name: Bank0_ValidateHighScoreSignature
units.summary: Keep the local high-score records when RAM07E6/07E7 contain AB/CD. Otherwise load the default screen and expand the seed records; $1F in the seed repeats across five fields.

units.name: Bank0_ExpandDefaultHighScores
units.summary: Copy encoded defaults backwards into RAM07B4 onward, expanding the blank marker. Write the AB/CD signature and initialize the title countdown.

units.name: Bank0_WaitThenInitializeTitle
units.summary: Wait while the frame countdown is nonzero, then initialize rendering, player availability and the initial level/scene. Reset seeds X=2 and the countdown at its preceding setup.

units.name: Bank0_EnsureSecondPlayerReserve
units.summary: Preserve nonzero reserve counters and give an empty counter three entries before the next screen setup.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeScenePresentation
units.summary: Hide sprites, request palette synchronization, disable rendering and load scene graphics through banked services. Level selects a palette pointer; six spaced sprite records make the prompt.

units.name: Bank0_BuildPromptSprites
units.summary: Alternate tile indices and copy six coordinate pairs into every other OAM record. Attributes are cleared.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForStartEdge
units.summary: Wait for bit $10 in the combined newly pressed buttons before entering scene initialization. This polling loop depends on NMI controller updates.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceSceneOrBoss
units.summary: Check player availability, finish the current scene and either enter its boss at scene four or increment the scene and reload graphics.

units.name: Bank0_CallBossSequence
units.summary: Call the boss sequence, then test player availability and advance the level or enter the ending. Artificial entry alone has not established a working boss state.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceLevelAfterBoss
units.summary: After boss completion test remaining players. Level five enters the ending; otherwise reset scene to one, advance level and initialize the next presentation.

units.name: Bank0_CallEndingSequence
units.summary: Request a palette transition and call the illustrated ending. The artificial scenario renders this screen; natural progression to it remains unresolved.

units.name: Bank0_PrepareGameOverRanking
units.summary: Clear player availability after the ending, disable background work and prepare the score display. Banked graphics setup precedes a Start-or-countdown wait.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForRankingDismissal
units.summary: Wait for a newly pressed Start or expiry of the frame countdown. NMI must continue updating input and the countdown.

units.name: Bank0_InsertQualifiedScores
units.summary: Normalize the two player scores, run name entry for qualifying players and insert each result at its ranked position. Return through title presentation.

units.name: Bank0_InsertHighScoreRecord
units.summary: A selects a player's three name bytes; X is the rank. Shift lower records down, then store name, six encoded score digits and a packed level/scene byte. The local offset table has five ten-byte records.

units.name: Bank0_FindHighScoreRank
units.summary: X/Y form a zero-page pointer to six encoded score digits. Compare lexicographically against five ranked records; return rank 0..4 or $FF when none is lower. Equal scores continue to the next rank.

units.name: Bank0_RunSceneIntro
units.summary: Initialize scene state, enable display work and repeatedly update until the combined player/reserve test or scene counter ends the loop.

units.name: Bank0_CheckStartForInterlude
units.summary: Check two newly pressed button bytes for Start and an eligible player state. Save the streaming flag while an interlude runs; restore it before selecting the next sound request.

units.name: Bank0_SuspendStreamForInterlude
units.summary: Temporarily disable background streaming, initialize an audio sequence and wait for Start with a short software delay between updates.

units.name: Bank0_DelayAndPollStart
units.summary: Nested X/Y delay followed by frame synchronization and a Start test. X is intentionally consumed by the delay.

units.name: Bank0_QueueAudioAfterInterlude
units.summary: Set a pending music selection and restore the display-work flag before returning.

units.name: Bank0_StartMusicSequence
units.summary: A selects a music header. Initialize four channels at stride four with sequence pointers and a one-tick delay; clear modulation/envelope state. The tempo increment comes from the header table.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeMusicChannels
units.summary: Copy two pointer bytes per channel from the selected eight-byte header; channel RAM arrays are interleaved at offsets 0,4,8,12.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateAudioChannels
units.summary: Advance an eight-bit tempo accumulator and use its carry-derived sign to gate sequence ticks. Iterate four channels, servicing music and sound effects independently.

units.name: Bank0_TickMusicChannel
units.summary: On a tempo tick, decrement the note timer and parse the channel stream. Negative bytes select notes; nonnegative bytes dispatch commands. Outside a tick only modulation and register output are refreshed.

units.name: Bank0_ReadMusicToken
units.summary: Read at the stream pointer plus Y. Preserve Y while looking up note periods and restoring envelope/vibrato state.

units.name: Bank0_PrepareNotePeriod
units.summary: Set modulation counters and fetch the note timer low/high fields. The fourth channel uses a distinct period mapping for noise.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceMusicStream
units.summary: Use an explicit duration byte unless a persistent duration is active, then advance the saved stream pointer past consumed bytes.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateAudioModulation
units.summary: Service channel timers, temporary signed pitch slides, oscillation and volume envelopes before writing APU shadows. Per-channel arrays use stride four.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyTemporaryPitchSlide
units.summary: Restore the active signed pitch step, expire its duration and choose the reversed phase when its secondary counter is active. Add the sign-extended step to the channel's 16-bit period.

units.name: Bank0_UpdatePitchOscillation
units.summary: At each reload interval add a signed step to the 11-bit timer and reverse the step after the configured run length.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateVolumeEnvelope
units.summary: Gate envelope movement with per-channel counters and a target nibble. Stop the envelope when the low volume nibble matches its target.

units.name: Bank0_ReverseEnvelopeDirection
units.summary: Restore the envelope endpoint and invert its movement counter to reverse the next envelope leg, then join the common register update.

units.name: Bank0_RestoreMusicRegisters
units.summary: Force the next timer-high write and restore the channel sweep register after an effect releases the channel.

units.name: Bank0_WriteMusicRegisters
units.summary: Combine control bits with volume, write timer low, and write timer high only when it differs from the previous shadow. X is the APU channel stride.

units.name: Bank0_StartPulseOneEffect
units.summary: Select A as the effect for the first pulse channel; the common loader avoids restarting the same effect.

units.name: Bank0_StartPulseTwoEffect
units.summary: Select the second pulse channel for the shared effect loader.

units.name: Bank0_StartTriangleEffect
units.summary: Select the triangle channel for the shared effect loader.

units.name: Bank0_StartNoiseEffect
units.summary: Select the noise channel unless its protected effect is already active.

units.name: Bank0_LoadEffectHeader
units.summary: Use the even part of the effect selector as a pointer-table offset. Separate duration and control nibbles, copy sweep/timer shadows, then advance into the effect stream.

units.name: Bank0_TickSoundEffect
units.summary: Update the packed duration state and read the effect stream. A zero token releases the effect and restores music or silences the channel; other tokens provide volume and timer fields or dispatch commands.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyEffectToken
units.summary: Extract volume and timer-high bits, preserving unrelated control bits. Write timer high only when the three low bits change; timer low is always written.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceEffectPointer
units.summary: Advance the effect pointer by Y plus one and propagate the page carry.

units.name: Bank0_DispatchAudioCommand
units.summary: Double the token into the adjacent 23-word handler table. Save X while loading the destination into scratch RAM and dispatch indirectly. Stream format supplies the selector; the table extent is established by handler boundaries rather than a selector mask.

units.name: Bank0_StopMusicChannel
units.summary: Clear the music-active flag and enter the common silence path.

units.name: Bank0_ReleaseEffectControlFlag
units.summary: Clear the effect control low bit and continue the shared effect parser after consuming the command.

units.name: Bank0_ClearFixedNoteDuration
units.summary: Disable the channel's persistent duration and resume the music parser.

units.name: Bank0_SetFixedNoteDuration
units.summary: Read the next stream byte as the persistent note duration, then resume parsing.

units.name: Bank0_SetChannelControlCommand
units.summary: Read control, sweep and timer-high parameters from the stream, update volume state and resume token parsing.

units.name: Bank0_SetChannelVolume
units.summary: Store the volume and refresh the saved envelope start value when its high-bit mode is active.

units.name: Bank0_JumpMusicStream
units.summary: Read a little-endian destination from the bytecode stream, replace its pointer and resume at the new stream's first token.

units.name: Bank0_CallMusicSubstream
units.summary: Read a repeat/count parameter, save the return pointer after the embedded destination, and replace the current stream pointer with that destination.

units.name: Bank0_RepeatOrReturnMusicSubstream
units.summary: Decrement the saved repeat count. Repeat the stored destination while nonzero; on expiry resume after its embedded two-byte address. X remains the channel stride.

units.name: Bank0_SetPitchOscillationCommand
units.summary: Read run length, reload delay and signed step parameters; initialize the step counters before resuming stream parsing.

units.name: Bank0_DisablePitchOscillation
units.summary: Clear the channel oscillation run length and resume token parsing.

units.name: Bank0_SetPositivePitchSlide
units.summary: Read pitch-slide timing and step parameters, then use the positive step. The companion entry negates the step before joining the common store.

units.name: Bank0_SetNegativePitchSlide
units.summary: Read slide parameters and negate the step, producing descending rather than ascending pitch motion.

units.name: Bank0_ReadPitchSlideParameters
units.summary: Consume reload interval, delay plus one and duration. Seed the live delay immediately; return the final byte as the signed step magnitude.

units.name: Bank0_SetFixedVolumeCommand
units.summary: Disable envelope movement and set a fixed volume nibble with its control bit.

units.name: Bank0_DisableVolumeEnvelope
units.summary: Clear the envelope start/enable state and resume the music parser.

units.name: Bank0_SetVolumeEnvelopeCommand
units.summary: Preserve the initial volume and configure delay, reload interval and target volume from the stream.

units.name: Bank0_SetOscillatingVolumeEnvelope
units.summary: Configure envelope mode two, endpoint, half-endpoint and delay plus one, then join common envelope setup with the remaining stream parameter.

units.name: Bank0_DisableEnvelopeMode
units.summary: Clear the channel envelope mode and resume token parsing.

units.name: Bank0_SetTempoIncrement
units.summary: Use the next byte as the global music tempo increment. The additive entry starts with the existing increment, allowing relative tempo changes.

units.name: Bank0_AddTempoIncrement
units.summary: Add the next stream byte to the current tempo increment through the common setter.

units.name: Bank0_ClearTransposeBase
units.summary: Start the shared transpose command from zero; the relative entry instead starts from the current channel transpose.

units.name: Bank0_AddMusicTranspose
units.summary: Add the next stream parameter to the per-channel note transpose, then resume parsing.

units.name: Bank0_AccumulateMusicTranspose
units.summary: Start with the current transpose and enter the additive transpose command.

units.name: Bank0_SetAllChannelTranspose
units.summary: Copy one stream parameter to all four channel transpose fields, then continue parsing the current channel.

units.name: Bank0_ResetPlayerAvailability
units.summary: Set both availability bytes to the $F2 sentinel and clear both reserve counters.

units.name: Bank0_EnableBackgroundAndSprites
units.summary: Set both rendering-enable bits in the PPUMASK shadow.

units.name: Bank0_DrainActorsAndBackgroundObjects
units.summary: Run repeated frame/actor updates while clearing rectangle arrays. Release background states to their decay phase and wait until active actors and background objects disappear; final scene preserves its special slot-zero behavior.

units.name: Bank0_RunTitleWait
units.summary: Start the initial audio sequence, prepare the title and test for eligible players/reserves before the next presentation routine.

units.name: Bank0_TestPlayersAndReserves
units.summary: Check player state pairs and optionally trigger an effect. Return Z from the availability/reserve test; $F2 is the inactive sentinel.

units.name: Bank0_SignalPlayerAvailability
units.summary: Play the pulse-two effect and return nonzero to the title availability test.

units.name: Bank0_PrepareTitleAndWait
units.summary: Reset input overrides, blank rendering, load title graphics and synchronize. Run a bounded countdown while checking Start participation; then request a palette transition.

units.name: Bank0_PollTitleParticipation
units.summary: Enable title display work and test newly pressed Start until participation or countdown expiration.

units.name: Bank0_ContinueTitlePresentation
units.summary: Reset input overrides, blank rendering and run the timed title participation screen. Clear PPU increment mode while building the display and restore it on return.

units.name: Bank0_RunTimedTitleParticipation
units.summary: Blank rendering, clear PPU increment mode, load the score/title display and poll participation until accepted or the frame timer expires. Restore increment mode before returning.

units.name: Bank0_AcceptPlayerStart
units.summary: Check each controller's Start edge; initialize the selected player and set the other reserve counter. Return zero when accepted, $FF otherwise.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeNewGame
units.summary: Set level and scene to one, initialize status bytes with their sentinels, and clear eligible per-player action state.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeSceneGraphics
units.summary: Start scene music, disable rendering and compute the doubled scene index. Load scene metadata, banked graphics and palette pointers; seed OAM helper records.

units.name: Bank0_SetPromptSpriteAttributes
units.summary: Initialize paired OAM attribute bytes, including horizontal flip for the mirrored half.

units.name: Bank0_DispatchSpriteUpdatePhase
units.summary: Increment a rolling phase and dispatch through an eight-entry indirect table. Each phase handles part of the two-player sprite preparation.

units.name: Bank0_SelectFirstPlayerGraphicStream
units.summary: Set the PPU upload destination and convert the first player's current selector into a stream pointer.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceFirstPlayerAnimation
units.summary: Save the previous selector, install the new one and choose tile indices for the first player's eight sprites.

units.name: Bank0_SelectSecondPlayerGraphicStream
units.summary: Set the PPU upload destination and resolve the second player's graphic selector.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceSecondPlayerAnimation
units.summary: Save the second selector and assign a new eight-sprite tile sequence.

units.name: Bank0_SelectFirstPlayerAlternateStream
units.summary: Choose the alternate upload area for the first player's graphics.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceFirstPlayerAlternateTiles
units.summary: Install the first player's next graphic selector and alternate tile base.

units.name: Bank0_SelectSecondPlayerAlternateStream
units.summary: Choose the alternate upload area for the second player's graphics.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceSecondPlayerAlternateTiles
units.summary: Install the second player's next graphic selector and alternate tile base.

units.name: Bank0_FillEightSpriteTiles
units.summary: Write eight tile indices at OAM stride four, increasing the tile by two for 8x16 sprites.

units.name: Bank0_ResolvePlayerGraphicPointer
units.summary: Double the selector, index the word table at $C913 and replace the scratch pointer with the selected stream address.

units.name: Bank0_BuildPlayerSprites
units.summary: Select each player's pose list, optionally substitute the neutral pose, and expand up to eight coordinate pairs into OAM. Negative horizontal coordinates take the mirrored path; $FF hides the remaining records.

units.name: Bank0_BuildFirstPlayerNormalPose
units.summary: Add pose offsets to the first player position. Negative Y offsets remain absolute; use palette zero.

units.name: Bank0_HideRemainingFirstPlayerSprites
units.summary: Fill unused OAM Y fields with $FF through the eight-sprite limit.

units.name: Bank0_BuildFirstPlayerMirroredPose
units.summary: Negate horizontal pose offsets around the player anchor. Retain negative hidden Y coordinates, apply mirrored attributes and emit eight sprite records.

units.name: Bank0_FinishFirstMirroredSpriteRecord
units.summary: Read the mirrored vertical displacement, retaining negative hidden coordinates. Write the flipped attribute and advance four bytes to the next OAM record.

units.name: Bank0_BuildSecondPlayerPose
units.summary: Perform the analogous pose selection for the second player, using its own position and palette one.

units.name: Bank0_BuildSecondPlayerNormalPose
units.summary: Expand coordinate pairs for the second player with a maximum sixteen-byte source span.

units.name: Bank0_HideRemainingSecondPlayerSprites
units.summary: Hide the remaining second-player OAM records until all eight slots are covered.

units.name: Bank0_BuildSecondPlayerMirroredPose
units.summary: Reflect X offsets around the second player anchor, retain negative hidden Y values and emit eight sprites with player-two palette and horizontal flip.

units.name: Bank0_FinishSecondMirroredSpriteRecord
units.summary: Apply the same signed vertical-coordinate rule for player two, write palette plus horizontal flip and finish eight OAM records.

units.name: Bank0_UploadHalfPageToPpu
units.summary: Reset the PPU latch, write the destination and transfer exactly 128 bytes from the source pointer. Advance both source and destination by 128 with carry.

units.name: Bank0_BuildPlayerActionSprites
units.summary: Conditionally render player action indicators and a selected projectile marker. Coordinate offsets and blink phases come from small tables/frame bits.

units.name: Bank0_BuildSelectedProjectileMarker
units.summary: Use the selected slot's flags and frame bits to place an extra marker sprite.

units.name: Bank0_AnimateActionMarker
units.summary: Turn frame bits into an OAM record index and reuse the action-marker writer.

units.name: Bank0_ClearEligibleActionState
units.summary: Clear each player's action state only when its availability byte is not the inactive sentinel.

units.name: Bank0_ClearPlayerPresentationState
units.summary: Reset both pose timers to $FF and clear auxiliary counters and graphic/background activity state shared by scene transitions.

units.name: Bank0_RunSceneCompletionTransition
units.summary: Reset presentation, start transition music and use bank-two services to initialize and finish the sequence. Continue frame updates until the active player's action state reaches $50; NMI and valid action initialization are prerequisites.

units.name: Bank0_RunBossSequence
units.summary: Initialize boss-related counters, banked setup and staged transfers, then enter repeated updates. Required dependent state for an active boss remains unresolved; this is the mechanical contract only.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForBossSetupDelay
units.summary: Run updates until the frame countdown expires, then compute the scene index and invoke a banked setup service.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForBossTransferOne
units.summary: Continue frame updates while the banked transfer counter remains nonzero, then request the second transfer.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForBossTransferTwo
units.summary: Wait for the second transfer to drain before continuing boss setup.

units.name: Bank0_PrepareBossIntroduction
units.summary: Clear the background object selector, invoke bank-two boss setup and wait ten countdown ticks before selecting level-specific music.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateBossLoop
units.summary: Refresh sprites, call banked boss behavior, update the common scene and test its completion/player state.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceBossCompletionStatus
units.summary: Advance both players encoded completion counters, drain scene objects and handle the final-level actor/countdown wait before returning.

units.name: Bank0_FinishBossAndDrainScene
units.summary: Advance player-two status, drain scene objects and disable the boss display flag. Final level additionally releases the special actor and waits for its frame countdown.

units.name: Bank0_IncrementPlayerStatus
units.summary: Increment a player's encoded status unless it is one of the two fixed sentinels $F2/$FB.

units.name: Bank0_DrainCurrentScene
units.summary: Clear the transition scratch state, stop actor generation and use the common drain loop before proceeding to the next scene.

units.name: Bank0_RunIllustratedEnding
units.summary: Start ending music, load the ending graphics through a banked service and initialize palette/text transfer. The saved artificial route confirms this display, not natural reachability.

units.name: Bank0_BeginEndingTextRow
units.summary: Restore the row destination, fetch the next byte and queue it for NMI. A negative byte acts as a row control token; zero continues immediately.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForEndingTextByte
units.summary: Synchronize frames around each queued byte. Negative control tokens advance the destination by one tile row; an eight-row countdown bounds the text block.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForEndingStart
units.summary: Wait for the combined Start edge before requesting a palette transition.

units.name: Bank0_RestorePostEndingDisplayMode
units.summary: Clear the tall-sprite control bit and restore PPU address increment mode after ending text output.

units.name: Bank0_ComputeTwoPlayerRanking
units.summary: Convert twelve encoded score digits to the high-score alphabet, find both ranks and resolve their relative ordering. Pack qualifying rank plus one in two nibbles; $FF marks a player who did not qualify. Bounded cases confirm the lower-score rank increments even with distinct initial ranks; insertion recomputes ranks later.

units.name: Bank0_OrderRankingCandidates
units.summary: Compare six player score digits to choose insertion order, then advance the lower-priority candidate rank. The preceding self-comparison cannot distinguish rank equality; its original intent remains unresolved.

units.name: Bank0_PackQualifiedRanks
units.summary: Encode each nonnegative rank plus one into its player's nibble. Return zero when neither player qualifies.

units.name: Bank0_RunHighScoreNameEntry
units.summary: Prepare banked graphics, palette and two independent three-character name editors. Cursor values 1..33 select a grid or special action; each player's rank nibble enables its editor.

units.name: Bank0_MoveNameEntryCursors
units.summary: Use directional edge bits to move through the five-column grid with explicit edge and special-action remapping. Inactive players retain cursor zero.

units.name: Bank0_RenderNameEntryCursors
units.summary: Use parallel X/Y coordinate tables to arrange each player's cursor sprites. Map the selected grid index to a glyph or special-action icon.

units.name: Bank0_DebounceNameEntryButtons
units.summary: Observe held-button sign bits over a short frame window, retaining one selected glyph and release count per player. The counters distinguish an accepted press from a continuing hold.

units.name: Bank0_CommitFirstPlayerNameAction
units.summary: Ordinary glyphs update one of three name slots and advance the write cursor. Special selections clear, backspace or finish the editor; a negative write cursor means finished.

units.name: Bank0_CommitSecondPlayerNameAction
units.summary: Apply the same name-edit actions to player two's three-byte name buffer. Return to cursor polling until both write cursors are negative.

units.name: Bank0_FinishNameEntry
units.summary: Wait eighty synchronized frames, restore PPU increment mode and return through the common frame synchronization.

units.name: Bank0_MapNameCursorToGlyph
units.summary: Return ordinary cursor indices directly; map indices $1F/$20 and the remaining special index to their display glyphs $49/$4C/$4F.

units.name: Bank0_CheckPlayerRegionContacts
units.summary: Process both player coordinate pairs against fifteen enabled rectangles using coordinates divided by eight. Store the matched region index for subsequent collision handling.

units.name: Bank0_CheckOnePlayerRegion
units.summary: Skip players with an active indirect action; an input/state condition can enter the hit routine. Otherwise test an active player against rectangle bounds.

units.name: Bank0_TestPlayerRectangles
units.summary: Require an active player and graphic state, then normalize position to eight-pixel cells and scan enabled half-open rectangles.

units.name: Bank0_UpdatePlayerRegionState
units.summary: Process both player region markers. A negative marker selects a different update amount; region $0F means no contact.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateOnePlayerRegionState
units.summary: Decode the contact marker and update the selected player accumulator. Rectangle hits reduce health, release exhausted background state and generate contact effects before crediting the player.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyRectangleHit
units.summary: Use the decoded rectangle index to subtract damage from its enable/health byte. On exhaustion release its background state, handle the scene-$0C paired rectangle exception, spawn a visual effect at its center and credit the player's score accumulator.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeSceneActors
units.summary: Reset scene counters and display flags, clear/setup OAM through banked helpers, initialize actor scripts and player coordinates, then enter a banked initialization service.

units.name: Bank0_HideActorsThenUpdateScene
units.summary: Hide the actor sprite range before entering the common per-frame scene update.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateScene
units.summary: Disable NMI during main-thread scene work, rotate the update phase, maintain timers, update players/actors/collisions and banked services, then synchronize rendering at the frame boundary.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateSceneSubsystems
units.summary: Initialize contact sentinels, perform player and actor work, process pending music requests and update sprite/collision systems.

units.name: Bank0_ClearPendingSoundRequest
units.summary: Clear the global pending sound selector before joining the common update path.

units.name: Bank0_ComputeSceneProgress
units.summary: Derive progress from the initial and remaining counters, cap to the initial value, then update status counters and rendering.

units.name: Bank0_SynchronizeSpriteZeroAndFrame
units.summary: Wait for the sprite-zero status transition, apply a calibrated delay and optionally stream 128 bytes to PPU; finally wait for NMI completion. Timing assumptions are NTSC baseline only.

units.name: Bank0_RunStageBanner
units.summary: Initialize actors and display, stream banner graphics, build level/scene digit sprites and delay before enabling active scene flags.

units.name: Bank0_BuildStageBannerDigits
units.summary: Set fixed banner tiles and convert one-based level/scene values to digit tile indices.

units.name: Bank0_PositionStageBannerSprites
units.summary: Space banner sprites horizontally while skipping the center coordinate, then fill the two banner rows.

units.name: Bank0_WaitStageBannerCountdown
units.summary: Update frames until the countdown ends, restore scene flags and wait for the palette request to complete.

units.name: Bank0_ResetActivityTimer
units.summary: Install a two-byte activity timer and a frame mask controlling slower per-slot countdowns.

units.name: Bank0_ClearInputOverrides
units.summary: Clear the two input override bytes so normal controller processing can run.

units.name: Bank0_SetGraphicUploadDestination
units.summary: Use A as the high PPU address byte and fix its low byte at $80.

units.name: Bank0_ConsumePlayerReserve
units.summary: For inactive players with Start held, consume a nonzero reserve counter and initialize rejoining pose, graphic state and action delay.

units.name: Bank0_ResetRejoiningPlayerPose
units.summary: Initialize the player's core state, pose delay and inactive graphic selector before rejoining the shared player update.

units.name: Bank0_InitializePlayerEntry
units.summary: Preserve X, set an encoded availability state, initialize its action pointer sentinel and clear six encoded display/status bytes.

units.name: Bank0_ClearActorAndProjectileState
units.summary: Clear actor active fields, initialize six projectile Y slots and clear small effect state. $FF denotes an unused projectile.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeActorScripts
units.summary: Compute scene metadata pointers and flags, initialize ten actor slots and expand four-byte records from a $FF-terminated list into parallel RAM arrays.

units.name: Bank0_ReadInitialActorRecords
units.summary: Read position, type and script fields, preserve the script record address and advance to the next record until $FF.

units.name: Bank0_ClearActorActivity
units.summary: Clear two ten-entry actor-state arrays; X returns as $FF.

units.name: Bank0_ReadActorScript
units.summary: Form a script address from each slot's saved relative pointer. $FF selects a new script or retires the slot; tokens $F0 and above use compact predefined records.

units.name: Bank0_SelectAlternateActorScriptPage
units.summary: Build the alternate script pointer using the table high byte and a fixed page displacement. Preserve bank/flag bits in the actor script state before joining common pointer processing.

units.name: Bank0_DecodeActorScriptToken
units.summary: Expand shorthand tokens through three tables or consume a full three-byte state record. Certain kinds spawn auxiliary objects or projectiles.

units.name: Bank0_ReadActorScriptDuration
units.summary: Optionally consume an extra state parameter, save the duration and advance the stored relative pointer by the consumed length.

units.name: Bank0_DeactivateActorMotion
units.summary: Clear actor packed motion, active state and extra state, then set its duration sentinel to $FF. Other actor-array fields retain their previous values until reallocated.

units.name: Bank0_ClearActorSlotState
units.summary: Clear actor state and extra state, set its duration sentinel to $FF and return to the allocator's caller.

units.name: Bank0_AllocateActorFromSchedule
units.summary: Use the cyclic schedule cursor to find an available entry and expand its five-byte record. Avoid conflicting active kinds before entering the actor script parser.

units.name: Bank0_CheckExclusiveActorKinds
units.summary: Scan other actor slots for the restricted kind range. On conflict mark the new kind invalid and continue the common allocation path; actor identities remain unresolved.

units.name: Bank0_RetireScheduledActor
units.summary: Release the actor slot and assign its schedule-channel countdown five before continuing schedule processing.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceActorScheduleCursor
units.summary: Increment the schedule cursor and wrap only when the new byte equals ActorScheduleCount, then skip the actor slot. Values already beyond count do not wrap on this path.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateActorsAndBuildOam
units.summary: Wait out the spawn delay, then process ten actor slots: parse expired scripts, advance motion, handle collisions and lifetimes, sort records and render grouped sprites.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateOneActor
units.summary: Duration zero requests the next script; $FF requests a schedule allocation. Other slots proceed with movement and rendering.

units.name: Bank0_MoveActorFromPackedVelocity
units.summary: Split the packed movement byte into direction components and use a four-phase delta table. Retire an actor that crosses the vertical bounds.

units.name: Bank0_MoveSpecialActor
units.summary: Handle motion selector $88 using either direct stream positions or a scene-specific oscillation. Exact actor identity remains unresolved.

units.name: Bank0_HandleActorKindContacts
units.summary: Special kinds trigger projectile generation or a short horizontal separation test against other actors.

units.name: Bank0_MarkLinkedProjectileInactive
units.summary: Save the signed projectile slot selector; nonnegative selectors mark the corresponding projectile Y as $80 before resuming actor handling.

units.name: Bank0_ReverseActorFacingAndMotion
units.summary: Toggle bit seven in actor state and packed motion, then restart its duration at $50. Join the common actor continuation.

units.name: Bank0_TickActorDuration
units.summary: Decrement nonnegative, nonzero durations once per eight-phase interval; continue through all ten slots.

units.name: Bank0_SortActorParallelArrays
units.summary: Perform adjacent swaps when vertical positions are out of order. Swap every parallel field together so scripts, lifetimes and positions retain slot identity.

units.name: Bank0_GroupActorsForRendering
units.summary: Alternate traversal direction each update and group nearby vertical positions. This changes sprite order to distribute OAM priority/flicker.

units.name: Bank0_HideUnusedActorOam
units.summary: Fill remaining sprite Y fields with $FF through the end of the OAM page.

units.name: Bank0_RenderActorGroup
units.summary: Render the inclusive group in ascending or descending order according to the alternating phase flag.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateSmallEffects
units.summary: Update six projectiles and three small effects, choose a rotating OAM start, and render two transient effect records if active.

units.name: Bank0_RenderOneTransientEffect
units.summary: Choose an animation list from the effect countdown, clamp Y, set palette/clip fields and call the common metasprite renderer.

units.name: Bank0_MoveTransientEffectOnSeventhTick
units.summary: Low three lifetime bits gate motion. On tick seven use the upper lifetime bits to index parallel X/Y displacement tables and update the effect position.

units.name: Bank0_RenderAlternateAuxiliarySprite
units.summary: Set the sprite mode scratch byte to $80, call the shared metasprite renderer and join the auxiliary-object return path.

units.name: Bank0_RenderThreeAuxiliaryObjects
units.summary: Scan three active slots. Stream-based modes emit clipped metasprites; simple modes select a direction/expiry tile and write one sprite. The OAM cursor stops on byte wrap.

units.name: Bank0_EmitAuxiliaryMetaspriteRecord
units.summary: Read X displacement, tile and attributes from the selected stream and append an OAM record. Stop safely when the eight-bit OAM cursor wraps; preserve the outer object index on stack.

units.name: Bank0_EmitSingleAuxiliarySprite
units.summary: Write object X and fixed palette. An expired/special object blinks with frame bit three; ordinary objects choose a tile from the direction of their remaining major-axis distance.

units.name: Bank0_AllocateAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Preserve actor/script scratch and find one of three free slots. Initialize position from the actor, choose an available player target and derive signed line steps. Full pools leave existing objects unchanged.

units.name: Bank0_AimAuxiliaryObjectAtPlayer
units.summary: Copy actor Y, choose an available player with alternating frame parity and add a small frame-derived aim offset. Halve signed X distance and pass remaining vertical distance to the shared line-step initializer.

units.name: Bank0_AllocateProjectile
units.summary: Find a free slot among six projectile Y values, derive its kind from the actor type and initialize flags. Save/restore the caller's stream index.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeActorProjectileTarget
units.summary: Compute projectile Y with an actor-relative offset and choose an available player. Set signed horizontal speed/flags according to which side of the player's anchor the actor occupies; preserve outer actor and script indices.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateProjectiles
units.summary: For six slots, drain initial delay bits, integrate a signed fractional horizontal step and advance Y. Retire out-of-bounds projectiles, then test rectangle contacts and build OAM.

units.name: Bank0_IntegrateProjectileX
units.summary: Add the signed fractional step twice, propagating underflow/overflow into X. Advance Y once, or twice for one late-level slot.

units.name: Bank0_DeactivateProjectile
units.summary: Mark the projectile Y as $FF and clear the selected-projectile marker when it refers to this slot.

units.name: Bank0_TestProjectileRectangles
units.summary: Convert coordinates to eight-pixel cells and test all fifteen enabled rectangles. Retire a projectile on a hit; follow with a banked service and OAM setup.

units.name: Bank0_DecayRectangleContactState
units.summary: Decrement the rectangle lifetime and clear its background state's high bit when the lifetime reaches zero.

units.name: Bank0_BuildProjectileSprites
units.summary: Alternate forward/backward OAM placement by frame parity, preserving position and selected-projectile effects.

units.name: Bank0_AnimateSelectedProjectile
units.summary: Occasionally copy selected projectile coordinates into a transient effect slot. Return an animated vertical offset for its sprite.

units.name: Bank0_CreateProjectileContactEffect
units.summary: Copy projectile Y into a transient effect slot, give it six ticks and restore the outer rendering index.

units.name: Bank0_ChooseProjectileTileAndAttributes
units.summary: Decode flags into a tile/attribute lookup. Delayed projectiles use a fixed marker and remember their slot for another sprite writer.

units.name: Bank0_PrepareActorMetasprite
units.summary: Select actor position, palette, tile base and animation list, account for region contact and scene flags, then call the common metasprite renderer.

units.name: Bank0_SelectActorGraphicClass
units.summary: Discard hidden actors, decode kind and scene-dependent tile-bank selection, and prepare palette and animation flags.

units.name: Bank0_ResolveActorAnimation
units.summary: Handle region state and optional overlay graphics, then select a pointer list from kind and animation nibble. A zero animation falls back to a fixed list.

units.name: Bank0_RenderMetasprite
units.summary: Consume sprite triples until a negative leading byte. Offset Y above the anchor and X relative to it, clip horizontal wrap/range, apply tile base and attributes. X is the OAM cursor, Y the source index.

units.name: Bank0_HideClippedMetaspritePart
units.summary: Move clipped parts offscreen while still emitting the remaining sprite fields.

units.name: Bank0_FinishMetasprite
units.summary: Wrap the actor OAM cursor from $D4 to $C0 and save it for the next metasprite.

units.name: Bank0_RenderMirroredMetasprite
units.summary: Set horizontal flip, shift the anchor by eight and negate each relative X offset, retaining the same clipping rules.

units.name: Bank0_WriteMetaspriteTileAndFlags
units.summary: Write common attributes and tile plus base, then advance source by one and OAM by four.

units.name: Bank0_ChooseTransientEffectSlot
units.summary: Prefer an inactive one of two effect slots; if both are active, alternate selection with frame parity.

units.name: Bank0_WaitEightyFrames
units.summary: Call frame synchronization eighty times. Requires NMI progress; X is preserved by the frame service between countdown steps.

units.name: Bank0_RequestDefaultPalette
units.summary: Install the default palette pointer, set the pending flag and wait for NMI to clear it.

units.name: Bank0_RequestCurrentPalette
units.summary: Request the existing palette pointer and block until NMI services it.

units.name: Bank0_ToggleNametableBit
units.summary: Toggle bit $10 in the mapper shadow; this chooses AxROM single-screen nametable selection.

units.name: Bank0_ToggleAndWriteMapper
units.summary: Toggle mapper bit $10 for AxROM single-screen nametable selection, then write through the matching ROM byte 00 or 10. Under the bank-zero entry contract lower bank bits remain unchanged.

units.name: Bank0_WriteMapperByNametableBit
units.summary: Z from the preceding toggle selects the ROM byte 00 at A20B or 10 at A20C. Writing A through that matching value avoids bus conflicts; these cartridge writes do not alter ROM.

units.name: Bank0_RunBlankedBankTransfer
units.summary: Disable display work, synchronize, toggle the mapper upper mode, synchronize again and restore the normal display-work flag.

units.name: Bank0_CallBankOneTransferService
units.summary: Tail-call bank-one service two through the common AxROM trampoline. The service restores the caller's physical bank before returning.

units.name: Bank0_BuildHighScoreDisplay
units.summary: Load bank-one service five, set the palette stream and write the high-score background. Decode packed level/scene nibbles into display glyphs, then build score/name sprites from the five ten-byte records.

units.name: Bank0_WriteHighScoreBackgroundFields
units.summary: Walk thirty-four pointer/address pairs. Each points to a live glyph byte; write that byte to its PPU destination. Scratch pointers deliberately address both constants and computed RAM glyphs.

units.name: Bank0_BuildHighScoreOam
units.summary: Expand 29 three-byte layout records containing X, Y and score-buffer offset into OAM. Set palette zero and replace packed scene digits with separate tiles.

units.name: Bank0_HighlightQualifiedScoreRows
units.summary: Use packed ranking nibbles to select each player's score row and recolor three neighboring sprite attributes with player-specific palettes.

units.name: Bank0_ColorThreeScoreSprites
units.summary: Write palette A into three consecutive sprite attributes at the row-relative X offset.

units.name: Bank0_WritePackedSceneGlyphs
units.summary: Split Y into two nibbles, add the digit tile base $1F and write two OAM tiles at X and X+4.

units.name: Bank0_LoadTitleOam
units.summary: Invoke a banked screen service, install title palette and copy 160 bytes of static sprite records into OAM.

units.name: Bank0_LoadSceneBankedGraphics
units.summary: Compute the doubled scene index and invoke graphics service (Y=1, X=3); clear the background-work flag on return.

units.name: Bank0_DispatchSceneDependentServices
units.summary: Invoke graphics service 8, choose a second service by scene-index threshold and tail-call service zero in bank one.

units.name: Bank0_LoadScenePaletteAndBackground
units.summary: Load graphics twice across a nametable toggle, select the scene palette pointer and invoke the remaining banked scene services.

units.name: Bank0_UpdatePlayerStatusDigits
units.summary: Visit four pending counters for each player and propagate encoded display/status updates into their six-byte records.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateOnePlayerStatusDigits
units.summary: For each nonzero pending counter call its encoded digit update helper. Borrow/carry helpers maintain the $F2..$FB alphabet and clamp the terminal pair.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceEncodedStatusDigit
units.summary: Increment the encoded digit selected by Y. At the $FC boundary clamp this byte and its neighbor to $FB before returning.

units.name: Bank0_IncrementEncodedDigitWithSentinel
units.summary: Increment the encoded byte selected by Y. Reaching $FC clamps this and the adjacent digit to $FB; ordinary values store directly. Entry setup supplies the digit pair.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceStatusDigitFive
units.summary: Increment the fifth encoded digit unless at $FB. On rollover reset to the $F2 base and propagate into the neighboring encoded byte.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceStatusDigitFour
units.summary: Apply the same encoded increment/reset operation to the fourth digit.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceStatusDigitThree
units.summary: Apply the encoded increment/reset operation to the third digit.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceStatusDigitTwo
units.summary: Apply the encoded increment/reset operation to the second digit.

units.name: Bank0_CarryEncodedStatusPair
units.summary: Advance the higher encoded byte unless it is $FB. On rollover reset it to $F2 and advance the lower byte with the same rollover convention.

units.name: Bank0_ComputeDoubledSceneIndex
units.summary: Compute 2*(4*level-5+scene) and return it in A and Y. This assumes the supported small one-based level/scene values and carry established by the second shift; scene zero is not a valid natural selector.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyRenderingShadows
units.summary: Copy PPUMASK and PPUCTRL shadows to hardware, clear the display inhibit and wait for the next NMI.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyPpuControlShadow
units.summary: Write PPUCTRL then enter the display synchronization helper.

units.name: Bank0_EnableDisplayAndWait
units.summary: Clear display inhibit and wait for NMI so requested work is applied at a frame boundary.

units.name: Bank0_BlankSpritesAndRendering
units.summary: Hide sprites, disable NMI and clear background/sprite rendering bits while marking display work inhibited.

units.name: Bank0_DisableNmiAndRendering
units.summary: Disable NMI in the hardware PPUCTRL value without changing its shadow; inhibit display work and blank background/sprites.

units.name: Bank0_WaitForNmi
units.summary: Reapply PPUCTRL, set the one-byte pending semaphore and spin until NMI decrements it. A disabled/missing NMI leaves this wait active; this is the progression investigation frontier.

units.name: Bank0_WaitUntilNmiAcknowledged
units.summary: Poll the NMI semaphore. Only the interrupt handler clears it.

units.name: Bank0_HideBannerSpriteRange
units.summary: Hide a fixed middle OAM range using the common stride-four filler.

units.name: Bank0_HideActorSpriteRange
units.summary: Hide actor OAM records from byte $54 using the common filler.

units.name: Bank0_HideAllSprites
units.summary: Clear display request mode and set all 64 sprite Y values to $F8.

units.name: Bank0_HideSpriteRange
units.summary: Fill Y sprite records starting at OAM offset X with offscreen Y=$F8.

units.name: Bank0_FillSpriteYFields
units.summary: Write A into Y successive OAM records at stride four; X/Y are consumed.

units.name: Bank0_RenderRegionOverlay
units.summary: Find the scene's region overlay descriptor, suppress duplicates using a frame-local bit mask, emit sprite coordinates and derive clipping limits from region bounds.

units.name: Bank0_FindRegionOverlayRecord
units.summary: Scan variable records until a negative terminator or matching region index. Relative offsets select the corresponding graphic record.

units.name: Bank0_EmitRegionOverlaySprites
units.summary: Emit coordinate pairs with sequential tile numbers and fixed attributes until $FF, wrapping the OAM cursor at $D4.

units.name: Bank0_ComputeRegionClipBounds
units.summary: For ordinary overlays convert rectangle limits from cells to pixels; special signed records bypass clipping setup.

units.name: Bank0_NmiServiceBody
units.summary: Blank rendering during OAM DMA and VRAM work. Service display requests/palette/banked transfers, restore scroll and rendering, poll controllers, update timers/audio and acknowledge the main-thread semaphore before RTI.

units.name: Bank0_ServiceNmiDisplayRequests
units.summary: Select single-byte VRAM write, tile-cache work or blinking display work, then prioritize palette updates over banked transfer/background services.

units.name: Bank0_DispatchNmiBackgroundPhase
units.summary: Toggle nametable state and dispatch a phase-specific VRAM handler only when background work is enabled.

units.name: Bank0_NmiRestoreNametable
units.summary: Toggle the nametable selection before restoring the PPU destination and scrolling state.

units.name: Bank0_NmiRestoreScrollAndTimers
units.summary: Restore PPU address, mapper/scroll shadows, input, frame timers and audio. Interrupt entry preserved A/X/Y in the bank tail; this body restores them.

units.name: Bank0_TickScheduleCountdowns
units.summary: Under the frame mask, decrement nonzero schedule countdowns; maintain a modulo-23 auxiliary counter and alternating flags.

units.name: Bank0_AdvanceSceneUpdatePhase
units.summary: Advance the even phase modulo 26 and scan two fifteen-entry arrays to set a combined active-work flag.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateBlinkingDisplay
units.summary: Use a local counter to alternate a small sprite/text display. The alternate path writes a fixed two-row nametable panel before clearing the display request mode.

units.name: Bank0_DrawAlternateBlinkPanel
units.summary: Write a small two-row tile panel to the fixed nametable positions and rejoin the common display-state update.

units.name: Bank0_DrawBlinkingDisplay
units.summary: Fill sprite rows, write fixed nametable tiles and copy one of two terminated OAM templates selected by a counter bit.

units.name: Bank0_UploadPalette
units.summary: Write 32 palette bytes through a permutation table and clear the request flag. Scene/display modes substitute selected colors or a fallback palette pointer for negative entries.

units.name: Bank0_WriteNextPaletteColor
units.summary: Map each output index through the palette order table; apply display mode substitutions before writing PPUDATA.

units.name: Bank0_SubstituteLevelPaletteColors
units.summary: For special palette positions derive a four-color lookup from level and destination index.

units.name: Bank0_ReadControllers
units.summary: Latch both standard controllers, shift eight serial samples per port and compute newly pressed edges from held-versus-previous bits. Merge held/edge bytes and pass through optional banked input processing.

units.name: Bank0_ComputeControllerEdges
units.summary: New presses are (current XOR previous) AND current. Preserve held bytes, combine both ports and dispatch normal or override processing.

units.name: Bank0_ProcessOneControllerBanked
units.summary: Save the controller index and tail-call the banked input service. Effective bank context must be re-established after mapper calls.

units.name: Bank0_NmiPhaseRestoreOnly
units.summary: Return to the common NMI nametable/scroll restoration path.

units.name: Bank0_NmiBankedPhaseSix
units.summary: Invoke banked service six and return through common NMI restoration.

units.name: Bank0_NmiBankedPhaseSeven
units.summary: Select service seven and share the preceding banked phase call.

units.name: Bank0_UpdatePlayerStatusVram
units.summary: Render first-player status and six encoded digits, using inactive sentinels to blank absent players. Continue with second-player status after resetting the PPU latch.

units.name: Bank0_BlankFirstPlayerStatus
units.summary: Clear fixed status cells and write the first player's six-byte digit buffer through the common helper.

units.name: Bank0_WriteRepeatedStatusTiles
units.summary: Write X twice at the fixed PPU address before continuing the status row.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateSecondPlayerStatusVram
units.summary: Increment a display phase, write second-player status and blink fields, and reuse its digit uploader.

units.name: Bank0_FinishSecondPlayerStatusRow
units.summary: Write player-two encoded status bytes, expire the second graphic countdown and join the shared incremental HUD work.

units.name: Bank0_BlankSecondPlayerStatus
units.summary: Clear second-player status and adjacent fields before returning to common NMI restoration.

units.name: Bank0_WriteFirstPlayerDigitPrefix
units.summary: Write a prefix byte then upload six encoded display digits.

units.name: Bank0_WriteFirstPlayerDigits
units.summary: Write six bytes from the first player's digit array to the current PPU destination.

units.name: Bank0_WriteSecondPlayerDigits
units.summary: Write a blank prefix and six second-player digit bytes.

units.name: Bank0_DrawSceneProgressMeter
units.summary: Convert initial/current progress into filled and empty tile counts. Negative remaining counters select alternate graphics or palette states.

units.name: Bank0_DrawAlternateProgressState
units.summary: Negate the signed state; one case uploads 64 graphics bytes and another changes a palette entry.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateReserveStatusDigits
units.summary: Update encoded per-player status digits only when their pending counters are nonzero, then restore the NMI path.

units.name: Bank0_UploadPhaseSelectedBuffer
units.summary: Select a buffer/destination pair from the phase table and transfer its fixed count to VRAM.

units.name: Bank0_UploadBackgroundBuffers
units.summary: Upload two RAM buffer slices to fixed nametable/attribute destinations, then return directly to NMI scroll restoration.

units.name: Bank0_CopyRamBufferToPpu
units.summary: Copy X bytes from the indirect RAM pointer through PPUDATA; Y advances and X reaches zero.

units.name: Bank0_WriteQueuedPpuByte
units.summary: Clear the request, reset the PPU address latch, write one byte and advance the two-byte destination address.

units.name: Bank0_ReadPpuTileCache
units.summary: Rotate among six cache entries, derive a PPU address from its tile identifier and discard the buffered read. Copy source tiles to RAM, then select bytes through the permutation table and replicate each byte four times into PPU output.

units.name: Bank0_FinishCachedTileConversion
units.summary: Restore the requested PPU location, then select sixteen cached bytes from each RAM plane through a permutation table. Replicate each byte four times to form the expanded tile output.

units.name: Bank0_WriteFourExpandedTileBytes
units.summary: Write A four times to PPUDATA and decrement the outer X counter, returning its sign for the caller's loop.

units.name: Bank0_TickAuxiliaryObjects
units.summary: Visit three active small-object slots and call their lifetime update.

units.name: Bank0_DecrementAuxiliaryLifetime
units.summary: Subtract one from a live auxiliary lifetime. Positive pickup modes test player proximity; moving modes steer their signed line step and update the dominant/minor-axis error accumulator. Expiry converts a pickup once or emits a transient effect.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateAuxiliaryMotionOrPickup
units.summary: Y selects one of three auxiliary slots. Positive mode bit six makes a player pickup: check available players within sixteen horizontal units and grant pose, reserve/status or digit reward. Other modes continue signed target steering and integer line stepping.

units.name: Bank0_SteerAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Gate steering by mode and frame parity. Compare the remaining major-axis distance to the target; table-driven adjustments change the fractional vertical term before stepping.

units.name: Bank0_StepAuxiliaryLine
units.summary: Compare absolute X/Y extents and use a remainder accumulator to interleave signed axis steps. The dominant axis always advances; overflow/borrow determines the secondary step, producing an integer line trajectory.

units.name: Bank0_ExpireOrConvertAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Expired positive modes convert once to a rising pickup with mode bit six. Other modes allocate a short effect, notify the player hit path and possibly emit a tile effect at the former object position.

units.name: Bank0_SpawnAuxiliaryExpiryEffect
units.summary: Choose a free transient slot or alternate one by frame parity, copy the object's position and give it six ticks. Preserve Y across hit/effect helpers.

units.name: Bank0_StepAuxiliaryY
units.summary: Add the signed Y step to the selected object's Y position.

units.name: Bank0_StepAuxiliaryX
units.summary: Add the signed X step to the selected object's X position.

units.name: Bank0_BeginPlayerHit
units.summary: Save the player index and start a hit sound effect before the shared damage response. The response creates a transient effect and retires or redirects the contacting actor/projectile.

units.name: Bank0_AllocatePlayerAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Find a free one of three slots. Consume one encoded player status unit with borrow, start at the player's aim anchor and derive signed half-distance toward its target coordinates. A full pool returns without changing status.

units.name: Bank0_SetAuxiliaryObjectMode
units.summary: Store the caller scratch parameter and mode two in the allocated auxiliary object. The surrounding allocator supplies slot, actor position and target-derived line-step state.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeAuxiliaryLineSteps
units.summary: Store signed axis increments and absolute extents. Use the larger half-distance as the lifetime/error seed; short/special modes double lifetime and halve signed steps, while long paths halve their target threshold. Save mode and zero steering remainder.

units.name: Bank0_TrySpawnTimedAuxiliaryEffect
units.summary: Only eligible frame phases and an unused slot zero can spawn. Copy scratch X/Y and choose one of eight mode bytes, then initialize a downward path to Y=$C0. Carry clear signals success; carry set leaves the pool unchanged.

units.name: Bank0_TestPlayerActorCollisions
units.summary: Process each active player, derive a position-centered hit box and test auxiliary objects and ten actors. Type/state bits select special collision responses.

units.name: Bank0_TestOnePlayerCollisions
units.summary: Shift the player anchor by fixed offsets, refresh the activity timer and test absolute coordinate differences before actor-kind dispatch.

units.name: Bank0_FinishProjectileImpact
units.summary: Initialize a transient effect at projectile contact, attempt the timed auxiliary effect and restore the saved caller index.

units.name: Bank0_ScanActorCollisionCandidates
units.summary: Ignore inactive, protected and excluded actor states. Match region affinity and derive per-kind collision extents before position tests.

units.name: Bank0_TestActorCollisionExtents
units.summary: Use unsigned deltas for rectangular overlap. Contact dispatches special actor classes to linked-projectile cleanup or continuation-descriptor installation, then awards score and requests the noise effect.

units.name: Bank0_ActivateActorAuxiliaryEffect
units.summary: Only state-one actors try the timed effect. Successful allocation promotes the actor to state two; both paths rejoin the common actor scan.

units.name: Bank0_HandleSpecialActorContact
units.summary: For selected state nibbles allocate a small object or alter the actor script. Other kinds follow the common damage/state response.

units.name: Bank0_UpdateActorContactScript
units.summary: Split the saved script high byte into a low address nibble and a state counter; choose alternate scripts or reset a scene-specific countdown.

units.name: Bank0_InstallActorScriptFlags
units.summary: Merge a motion-table byte with scratch flags into the actor script high state, restore the player index and join actor effect bookkeeping.

units.name: Bank0_FinishScheduledActorActivation
units.summary: Store the updated schedule cursor, restore the actor index and install the fixed script selector before joining the activation tail.

units.name: Bank0_FinishActorActivation
units.summary: Clear actor duration, award the fixed contact value and request the noise effect while preserving actor and player indices on stack.

units.name: Bank0_ApplyActorContactDamage
units.summary: Reduce the high-nibble counter under frame/state conditions, preserve the low address nibble and choose the hit or retirement animation.

units.name: Bank0_RetireSpecialActorWithContactEffect
units.summary: Create a 24-tick contact effect at the actor position. A matching class marks its linked projectile inactive, then release the actor and join contact accounting.

units.name: Bank0_SelectActorContactContinuation
units.summary: Combine actor state/class flags to select a two-byte continuation descriptor. Install the chosen low byte, clear duration and run common contact/effect/score accounting.

units.name: Bank0_InstallActorContactDescriptor
units.summary: Pop the selected continuation byte into the actor script low field and clear duration. Then attempt auxiliary effects, award contact score and decrement the scene remaining count if nonzero.

units.name: Bank0_NextActorCollisionCandidate
units.summary: Continue scanning down through all ten actor slots; return after slot zero.

units.name: Bank0_AwardActorContactScore
units.summary: Extract the actor class high nibble, read its packed award descriptor and add the high component and decoded low component to the selected player's four-byte accumulator. X is player 0/1, Y initially actor index.

units.name: Bank0_IrqOrBrkDispatcher
units.summary: Save A and inspect the stacked status B bit. Hardware IRQ restores A and returns with RTI. BRK removes status, subtracts two from its stacked PC with page borrow and tail-enters the bank service. The service RTS resumes at BRK+1; no inline selector byte is consumed. X and Y already hold service and bank selectors.

units.name: Bank0_WritePpuAddressXY
units.summary: Write X then Y to PPUADDR as high/low address. Caller must have reset the PPU latch where required.

units.name: Bank0_InitializeDefaultScenePalette
units.summary: Call bank-one graphics service five, enable rendering shadows and set palette stream CE84 with synchronization pending. Tail-call the bank-one transfer service. This 21-byte routine replaces the disproved generic-data interpretation.

units.name: Bank0_CallServiceWithDisplayInhibited
units.summary: Inhibit display work around the banked service call and restore it afterward. Caller supplies Y bank and X service selector.

units.name: Bank0_CallAxromService
units.summary: Push mapper shadow, retain upper mode bits, combine destination bank Y and switch via the bus-safe table. Continue at the selected physical bank directory resolver with X as service selector. Its return path restores the original physical bank and stack.

units.name: Bank0_ResolveBankServiceAndRestore
units.summary: Double X and load the destination from CF2B's service directory into RAM01/02. Call RAM00's JMP trampoline; pop the old mapper value, restore the original physical bank through the bus-safe table and then restore its shadow. Services must return with stack balanced.

units.name: Bank0_RestoreMapperShadowAndReturn
units.summary: Restore the mapper shadow after the shared resolver has restored the physical bank from its saved stack value. RTS returns to the original caller in that restored bank.

units.name: Bank0_NmiBankEntry
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y and select the NMI service bank while retaining mapper upper bits. The common tail then jumps to the service handler in its effective bank.

units.name: Bank0_ResetBankEntry
units.summary: Disable interrupts and decimal mode and select bank zero through the bus-safe table. The identical bank-zero continuation jumps to CPU8000.

units.name: Bank0_ContinueResetInBankZero
units.summary: After mapper selection the common reset tail jumps to CPU8000 in bank zero. Physical bytes are retained separately for each image.

units.name: Bank1_ClearFirstNametable
units.summary: Reset the PPU latch, set address $2000 and write four pages of zero, clearing the 1024-byte nametable plus attribute block. Rendering must already be inhibited.

units.name: Bank1_LoadLevelGraphicStreams
units.summary: Use the one-based level to load source/length pairs, write several fixed graphics streams to CHR RAM and tail-call the PPU decoder for the final stream. Bank context is physical PRG slots [4,5,6,7].

units.name: Bank1_LoadTitleGraphicStreams
units.summary: Load three bounded compressed streams into nametable and pattern destinations, then tail-call a banked service. Source pointer and compressed byte count share scratch RAM with other banks.

units.name: Bank1_LoadTitleNametableAndPatterns
units.summary: Decode stream 9EC7 to PPU2000 with encoded count 01D8, then decode B79C to pattern address zero with count 0DFA. Counts belong to the compressed input contract.

units.name: Bank1_LoadEndingGraphicStreams
units.summary: Decode ending nametable/pattern streams and build forty sprite entries in an eight-row grid. Clear the background-work flag before constructing the OAM records.

units.name: Bank1_BuildEndingSpriteGrid
units.summary: Emit five sprite records per row, using table-selected tiles, eight-pixel X/Y spacing and palette zero; stop after forty entries.

units.name: Bank1_LoadScoreScreenAndGlyphs
units.summary: Decode A1C5 into PPU2000, patch two fixed tile columns and load the shared CE A7 pattern stream. The patch helper falls through to the final pattern upload.

units.name: Bank1_PatchSixGlyphRows
units.summary: Write five increasing tile values separated by buffered PPU reads in each of six rows, advancing the base PPU address by $40. Then load the shared pattern stream into PPU0000.

units.name: Bank1_LoadFixedScreenStream
units.summary: Select a fixed compressed stream and decode it into nametable $2000.

units.name: Bank1_LoadTwoPatternStreamsAndService
units.summary: Decode AB41 into pattern address zero and B753 into $0EC0, then tail-call bank-three service five. Rendering/latch setup remains caller-managed.

units.name: Bank1_ReloadSharedPatternStream
units.summary: Decode B79C to PPU0000 using encoded count 0DFA, then return.

units.name: Bank1_LoadTwoPatternPages
units.summary: Decode C596 to PPU0000 and CD17 to PPU1000 with their explicit compressed counts, sharing the signed-run decoder.

units.name: Bank1_LoadSharedGlyphPatterns
units.summary: Decode CEA7 to PPU0000 with compressed count 05EE and return through the shared decoder.

units.name: Bank1_LoadSceneGraphicStreams
units.summary: Use the doubled scene index to load four scene-dependent source/count/destination pairs. An absent second pointer skips that optional stream.

units.name: Bank1_LoadSceneAdditionalStreams
units.summary: Load further scene-selected streams using pointer/count and destination tables in this bank.

units.name: Bank1_SetPpuDestinationAndDecode
units.summary: Write X/Y as the PPU address high/low bytes, then decode the bounded stream at the scratch source pointer.

units.name: Bank1_DecodePpuRleCounted
units.summary: Decode literal and repeated-byte runs into PPUDATA. A nonnegative header copies header+1 literal bytes; a negative header repeats the following byte for two's-complement(header)+1 writes. The remaining count bounds consumed source bytes, not output size; output count is tracked separately.

units.name: Bank1_ReadPpuRleHeader
units.summary: Select literal versus repeated run from the sign bit. Each source-byte consumption advances the pointer and decrements the compressed input count.

units.name: Bank1_CopyPpuLiteralRun
units.summary: Copy sequential source bytes into PPUDATA while tracking a 16-bit output count; stop when the source-count helper reports exhaustion.

units.name: Bank1_CopyPpuRepeatedRun
units.summary: Negate the signed run header, read one value, and write it repeatedly. Advance the input only after the repeated run completes.

units.name: Bank1_AdvanceCountedRleSource
units.summary: Increment the 16-bit source pointer and decrement the compressed byte count. Return nonzero on exhaustion; the boundary tests differ from the related decoder copies.

units.name: Bank1_ReturnRleFinished
units.summary: Return A=$FF as the exhaustion signal.

units.name: Bank1_LoadScenePatternBanks
units.summary: Initialize tile-base slots, decode fixed patterns and use a packed scene mask to select additional pattern sets. Update tile bases from decoder output counts; then process a terminated list of extra tiles.

units.name: Bank1_LoadMaskedPatternSets
units.summary: Consume four mask bits, choose normal/alternate pointer tables from scene flags, decode selected sets and propagate cumulative tile-base values.

units.name: Bank1_LoadSceneExtraTiles
units.summary: Process a scene-selected list: values at least $10 select raw 16-byte patterns, while smaller values select compressed stream descriptors. A negative token terminates.

units.name: Bank1_ResolveRawPatternIndex
units.summary: Convert a token minus $10 to a sixteen-byte source offset and write two eight-byte pattern halves with blank companion planes.

units.name: Bank1_ResolveCompressedPatternDescriptor
units.summary: Use a four-byte descriptor to select source/count, decode and update cumulative tile bases for later objects.

units.name: Bank1_CopyMonochromeTileHalf
units.summary: Write eight source bytes followed by eight zeros, producing one two-plane tile with a blank second plane.

units.name: Bank1_CopyRawPatternRows
units.summary: Preserve Y, copy X groups of 32 bytes from the zero-page source pointer to PPUDATA and advance that pointer with carry. Restore Y before returning.

units.name: Bank1_ConvertDecodedBytesToTileBase
units.summary: Shift the sixteen-bit decoded output count left four positions and return its high part; this converts decoded byte totals to the game's tile-base increments.

units.name: Bank1_ReturnFromInterruptStub
units.summary: This vector target is a single RTI; no additional behavior is established here.

units.name: Bank1_CallAxromService
units.summary: Preserve the mapper shadow, combine Y with its upper bits and switch the 32 KiB bank before resolving the service selected by X.

units.name: Bank1_ResolveAxromService
units.summary: Use X to select a word pointer from the current bank service directory, patch RAM01/02 and call RAM00 JMP. Restore the stacked mapper value and physical bank before RTS. Y supplies the destination bank to the shared prefix.

units.name: Bank1_RestoreMapperShadowAndReturn
units.summary: Restore the mapper shadow after the shared resolver has restored the physical bank from its saved stack value. RTS returns to the original caller in that restored bank.

units.name: Bank1_NmiBankEntry
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y and select the NMI service bank while retaining mapper upper bits. The common tail then jumps to the service handler in its effective bank.

units.name: Bank1_ResetBankEntry
units.summary: Disable interrupts and decimal mode and select bank zero through the bus-safe table. The identical bank-zero continuation jumps to CPU8000.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeBossTransferOne
units.summary: Select level-specific source and chunk count for the first boss graphics transfer; initialize destination $1620.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeBossTransferTwo
units.summary: Select the second level-specific transfer source/count and destination from tables.

units.name: Bank2_UploadTwoBossChunks
units.summary: Transfer up to two sixteen-byte chunks per call, decrement the chunk counter and advance source and PPU destination pointers with carry.

units.name: Bank2_UploadNextBossChunk
units.summary: Stop when no chunks remain; otherwise reset the PPU latch and copy sixteen bytes before advancing both addresses.

units.name: Bank2_DispatchBackgroundWorkPhase
units.summary: Use the even phase byte as a word-table offset and jump indirectly to the selected handler.

units.name: Bank2_ReturnFromEmptyPhase
units.summary: This phase intentionally returns without work.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateFirstObjectTileGroup
units.summary: Select objects 0..4 and initialize the per-call work budget from the scene count before entering the shared tile updater.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateSecondObjectTileGroup
units.summary: Select objects 5..9 for the shared tile-buffer updater.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateThirdObjectTileGroup
units.summary: Select objects 10..14 for the shared tile-buffer updater.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateObjectTileGroup
units.summary: Skip all work when no active background objects exist. Iterate the selected five-entry slice with the scene's signed budget, updating each object's tile contribution.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateFirstObjectAttributeGroup
units.summary: Select objects 0..4 and initialize the work budget for packed attribute updates.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateSecondObjectAttributeGroup
units.summary: Select objects 5..9 for the attribute updater.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateThirdObjectAttributeGroup
units.summary: Select objects 10..14 for the attribute updater.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateObjectAttributeGroup
units.summary: Apply packed attribute changes to each selected object while the scene work budget remains nonnegative.

units.name: Bank2_TickBackgroundObjectStates
units.summary: For fifteen slots update animation phase when enabled, reduce positive countdowns and decrement live activity bytes. Signed state bits select different update behavior.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeBackgroundObjects
units.summary: Reset fifteen object slots and pointer sentinels, load the scene record pointer and expand packed records into RAM arrays. Set initial per-slot phases and decode update counts, modes and destinations.

units.name: Bank2_LoadBackgroundObjectRecords
units.summary: Read one scene-selected list. Each record contains packed state/mode fields and four pointer pairs or derived destinations; initialize entries through the scene's inclusive count.

units.name: Bank2_ExpandBackgroundObjectRecord
units.summary: Split packed duration/style fields into parallel arrays, preserve state bit semantics and unpack tile/attribute destination information. The final slot count is inclusive.

units.name: Bank2_CopyScratchStreamToRam
units.summary: X/Y supply destination low/high; A supplies the byte count. Copy from the source pointer through indexed indirect RAM stores. A zero count follows the 256-byte wrap behavior.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateBackgroundObjectTiles
units.summary: Interpret the slot state, resolve tile source and destination pointers, add a state-dependent offset, and copy rows. An active secondary layer selects an alternate source list.

units.name: Bank2_ResolveBackgroundTilePointers
units.summary: Preserve the slot index, mask state flags and combine paired RAM pointers with a state-indexed offset table.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateSecondaryObjectTiles
units.summary: Restore the slot and, for nonsigned active state, choose a secondary source and a destination two tile rows earlier.

units.name: Bank2_CopyTransparentTileRow
units.summary: Copy a row through indirect pointers: zero leaves the destination unchanged and $FF terminates the row. Advance source past the terminator and destination by 32 bytes.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateBackgroundObjectAttributes
units.summary: Resolve packed attribute data and destination positions from state/mode fields. Process the object's rows and optionally its secondary attribute contribution.

units.name: Bank2_ResolveObjectAttributeRows
units.summary: Compute the row count, source pointer and packed destination index, then apply one packed attribute run per row.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateSecondaryObjectAttributes
units.summary: Skip the secondary layer for a signed state or inactive object; otherwise resolve its additional attribute source.

units.name: Bank2_MergePackedAttributeRun
units.summary: Decode a run of two-bit palette values and merge each into the appropriate quadrant of a nametable attribute byte. A zero count ends the run; masks preserve the other quadrants.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeNextAttributeGroup
units.summary: Read four two-bit values per packed byte, rotate/select the current pair, combine with the destination quadrant and merge through mask tables.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeSceneBackgroundBuffers
units.summary: Initialize object records, decompress three RAM planes, update tile and attribute contributions in five-entry groups, then tick their state.

units.name: Bank2_LoadBossGraphicsStreams
units.summary: Load two scene-specific compressed streams and one fixed graphics stream at table-selected PPU destinations.

units.name: Bank2_DecodePpuRle
units.summary: Decode signed literal/repeated runs to PPUDATA with a compressed-input limit. This copy does not track output bytes and uses its own zero/borrow stopping convention; do not replace it with the other bank's decoder.

units.name: Bank2_ReadPpuRleHeader
units.summary: Nonnegative control copies control+1 bytes; negative control repeats its next byte for two's-complement(control)+1 outputs. Stop at the input-count boundary.

units.name: Bank2_RepeatPpuRleByte
units.summary: Negate the header and repeat one source byte before advancing to the next header.

units.name: Bank2_AdvanceRleInput
units.summary: Advance the source pointer and reduce the 16-bit compressed input count; a high-byte underflow returns the nonzero stop value.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeFirstRamPlane
units.summary: Resolve the scene stream and decode exactly 250 output bytes to $0400. Literal/repeated headers use the same signed run convention as the graphics loader; source Y is eight-bit.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeFirstRamPlaneRun
units.summary: Copy literal runs or repeat a single byte, stopping immediately at the plane's fixed output limit.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeSecondRamPlane
units.summary: Decode the second scene-selected stream into 250 bytes starting at $04FA with independent literal/repeated runs.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeThirdRamPlane
units.summary: Decode the third scene-selected stream into 252 bytes starting at $05F4; stop at the fixed output size.

units.name: Bank2_DecrementRemainingSceneCount
units.summary: Decrease the remaining scene counter only when it is nonzero.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateBossAndProjectileState
units.summary: For odd levels build boss sprites from three streams and a current pose. Then test six projectiles against both player positions and dispatch level-specific boss state updates.

units.name: Bank2_EmitBossSpriteParts
units.summary: Consume pose/coordinate streams until a negative terminator; combine coordinates with the boss anchor and alternate OAM direction by frame parity.

units.name: Bank2_CheckBossProjectilePlayerCells
units.summary: Compare six projectile positions to both players after quantizing to eight-pixel cells. A hit initializes a transient effect at the player and marks the projectile inactive.

units.name: Bank2_FinishBossProjectileHit
