units.summary: Copy the chosen player's coordinates to a transient effect, restore the projectile index and mark its Y=$FF before the shared continuation.

units.name: Bank2_DispatchLevelBossState
units.summary: Dispatch by one-based level to distinct boss update routines. The fourth-level fallback derives remaining scene count from three active flags.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateThirdLevelBoss
units.summary: Only on phase $16, count cleared state slots, initialize a countdown and manipulate several tile-pointer entries. Position and object activation derive from that countdown.

units.name: Bank2_FinishBossSpriteTemplate
units.summary: Write the final constant sprite tile/attribute pair while walking the template backwards in two-byte steps.

units.name: Bank2_MoveThirdLevelBossParts
units.summary: Step four tile destinations from the countdown, disabling parts whose arithmetic wraps. Convert countdown to boss anchor coordinates and activate another part as conditions permit.

units.name: Bank2_ActivateBossBackgroundSegment
units.summary: Set the selected background segment active with lifetime $28, release the indexed boss state and decrement its segment cursor.

units.name: Bank2_CheckFifthLevelBossParts
units.summary: When five part-state bytes are all zero, clear the shared boss progress byte.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateSecondLevelBoss
units.summary: When its state is $85, derive collision bounds from the boss anchor and periodically decrement remaining count. At phase $16 advance a scripted pattern and oscillating position.

units.name: Bank2_AdvanceSecondLevelBossPattern
units.summary: Cycle a pattern cursor, translate tokens into five part-state bytes, and reverse the positional ramp at its limits.

units.name: Bank2_PositionSecondLevelBossParts
units.summary: Store the ramp position, update boss anchor coordinates and distribute related tile/attribute destination indices among parts.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateFirstLevelBossSprites
units.summary: Update boss sprite state, derive its collision rectangle and animate the rectangular movement path. Periodic frame phases create falling auxiliary objects.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateRectangularBossMotion
units.summary: Derive collision rectangle bounds from the boss anchor, periodically emit a falling auxiliary object and select animation from frame phase. Move around a four-edge rectangular path; the high motion bit selects direction order.

units.name: Bank2_MoveBossAlongRectangle
units.summary: Dispatch four motion states with exact X bounds 7/$D1 and Y bounds $33/$59. At each corner choose the next state according to the saved direction bit.

units.name: Bank2_ClearBossWorkingState
units.summary: Clear eighty bytes of boss working state from RAM075A. Odd levels then load their twelve-byte anchor/state record; expand the counted background records, install the component script and enable background updates.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeBossBackgroundRecords
units.summary: Finish clearing the boss working area. Odd levels load twelve-byte sprite/motion state; all levels expand counted background records and install a second script pointer. Zero the actor scratch range and enable background updates.

units.name: Bank2_ReadLevelBackgroundRecordCount
units.summary: Use level minus one to select a stream pointer and return its first byte as record count, with Y advanced for the record reader.

units.name: Bank2_ExpandBossBackgroundRecord
units.summary: Read ten-byte packed records into parallel activity/style/decay, attribute and rectangle arrays. Split flags and style nibbles, resolve tile/attribute source pointers from the final selector and copy its high nibble to health. X is doubled only while accessing pointer arrays.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateBossScriptScheduler
units.summary: If the boss progress byte is zero, enter cleanup; otherwise update boss behavior and on alternating frames advance one script channel. Script tokens can change part graphics or allocate a projectile.

units.name: Bank2_ReadBossPartScript
units.summary: Read a channel pointer, update its cursor and select tile pointers for nonzero tokens. Special zero tokens lead to projectile records or a script restart.

units.name: Bank2_AllocateBossProjectileFromScript
units.summary: Find an unused projectile slot, preserve channel state and expand a three-byte projectile record relative to the boss anchor. Retry later if no slot is free.

units.name: Bank2_InitializeBossProjectileRecord
units.summary: Install projectile flags, relative coordinates and a table-selected horizontal step, then advance the channel script cursor by three.

units.name: Bank2_RestartBossPartScript
units.summary: Clear the per-channel script cursor and resume the shared boss-part interpreter with its initialized component stream.

units.name: Bank2_AllocateFallingBossObject
units.summary: Scan an eight-slot ring backwards for a Y value in the $E8..$EF inactive band. Install scratch position and signed vertical speed; a full ring leaves existing objects unchanged.

units.name: Bank2_RetireFallingBossObject
units.summary: Choose a free or alternating transient effect slot, copy position, set its 24-tick lifetime and mark the falling object inactive before continuing the scan.

units.name: Bank2_CopyBossSpriteTemplate
units.summary: Copy the static eight-entry sprite template from working RAM into OAM, walking backwards in paired fields and inserting the fixed final tile/attribute bytes.

units.name: Bank2_TestAndRenderFallingBossObject
units.summary: Treat the $C0 Y band as contact and $E8 as inactive. Nonnegative-speed objects test both active players in eight-pixel cells; remaining objects emit a sprite and update signed vertical motion.

units.name: Bank2_AdvanceFallingBossObject
units.summary: Choose tile by signed velocity and emit a palette-one sprite. Add half the signed velocity to Y; every second frame increase velocity until four. Preserve the object index across tile selection.

units.name: Bank2_DispatchPlayerActions
units.summary: Process both players. A nonzero action-pointer high byte jumps through that player's continuation; otherwise build a new action pointer from decoded input.

units.name: Bank2_DispatchOnePlayerAction
units.summary: Save player index, choose one of two action pointers, and dispatch it. Without an active continuation, input selects a word-table entry and clears action state.

units.name: Bank2_ResolvePlayerActionFromInput
units.summary: Mask input into a dispatch-table offset; a negative decoded input adds the alternate-mode bit before lookup.

units.name: Bank2_ClearPlayerActionPointerHigh
units.summary: Clear the high byte of the selected player's stored action pointer and return; this disables the indirect action entry.

units.name: Bank2_ResetPlayerAimMode
units.summary: Clear the player aim-mode byte and enter aim selection.

units.name: Bank2_MarkPlayerAimModeNegative
units.summary: Set the selected player's aim mode to $FF before joining the action transition.

units.name: Bank2_ComputePlayerAimPose
units.summary: Clear action continuation and quantize the difference between player X and aim anchor X into a clamped 1..7 direction. An alternate aim mode adds seven to the pose.

units.name: Bank2_MovePlayerRightSlowly
units.summary: Move the anchor right by two, select one of four poses from frame phase and clear aim mode/action pointer before returning.

units.name: Bank2_MovePlayerLeftSlowly
units.summary: Move the anchor left by two, select its four-frame pose cycle and clear aim mode/action pointer.

units.name: Bank2_MovePlayerRightFast
units.summary: Move the anchor right by three and select the pose from auxiliary-frame bits 3..4, then clear the indirect action state.

units.name: Bank2_MovePlayerLeftFast
units.summary: Move left by three and use the corresponding direction-dependent three-way pose selection before clearing action state.

units.name: Bank2_AdvancePlayerThreePoseAction
units.summary: Map action-state bits 3..4 to one of three poses, move right by two and increment state. The terminal selector clears aim mode and the action pointer.

units.name: Bank2_AdvancePlayerActionPose
units.summary: Decode action-state bits to select one of three poses or finish the action by clearing mode/continuation. Adjust the aim anchor and increment the action state.

units.name: Bank2_AdvanceRightPoseSequence
units.summary: Use action-state bits 3..5 to index a pose sequence. Nonzero poses move right by two and advance state; a zero terminator disables the action pointer and aim mode.

units.name: Bank2_AdvanceLeftPoseSequence
units.summary: Use the companion pose sequence while moving left by two. Its zero terminator uses the same action cleanup contract.

units.name: Bank2_AdvancePlayerDeathOrExitPose
units.summary: Clamp the horizontal anchor, derive poses from the action-state high nibble and advance the state. At the terminal pose clear graphics and consume availability; exhausted players receive the idle handler, others reset their delay and action fields.

units.name: Bank2_ClearPlayerStartHeldBit
units.summary: Clear bit $10 of the selected held-controller byte. This helper is also called from the waiting/reserve-state path.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateWaitingPlayerPose
units.summary: Check reserves and waiting action state, advance at a particular frame phase and alternate an inactive/waiting pose. Reset the player's graphic selector pair.

units.name: Bank2_RunScriptedPlayerScenePose
units.summary: Use scene and action-phase tables for X/Y anchors and animation, with separate player offset and packed scene flags. Early phase raises the shared Y anchor; later phases apply a shrinking Y adjustment. Advance action state once per four frames.

units.name: Bank2_MovePlayerToFixedAnchor
units.summary: Blink a terminal pose at state $FF. Otherwise move the player's anchor one pixel toward its table target, hold Y at $90 and increment the action counter until aligned.

units.name: Bank2_InstallFixedAnchorHandlers
units.summary: For each available player install the fixed-anchor movement handler into its stored action pointer.

units.name: Bank2_InstallScenePoseHandlers
units.summary: For each available player install the scene-scripted pose handler; inactive players keep their previous pointer state.

units.name: Bank2_InitializePlayerActionPointers
units.summary: Clear action continuations/vertical anchor and assign a waiting continuation to inactive players.

units.name: Bank2_CheckBothPlayersForHits
units.summary: Visit both available, nonimmune players and test nearby transient effects/projectiles when no action continuation is active.

units.name: Bank2_TestPlayerHitCandidates
units.summary: Compare transient effects and six projectiles against the player anchor using fixed horizontal extents. On contact clear action state and enter the shared hit animation setup.

units.name: Bank2_BeginPlayerHitState
units.summary: Clear player action state and enter its damage/animation transition. The selected handler sets pose/movement and eventually clears its stored action pointer.

units.name: Bank2_EnterPlayerExitSequence
units.summary: Reset pose delay and graphics, then install the death/exit animation handler as the player's next action pointer.

units.name: Bank2_UpdatePlayerMotionAndReticles
units.summary: Update motion for available players, select reticle width/timing from their graphic selector and emit paired OAM records. Held action bits and frame masks determine alternate reticle appearance.

units.name: Bank2_DrawFirstPlayerNormalReticle
units.summary: Use normal tile indices and width table for the first player's paired reticle sprites; update its active flag and Y coordinate.

units.name: Bank2_DrawSecondPlayerReticle
units.summary: Apply the equivalent state/mask checks and paired sprite setup for the second player.

units.name: Bank2_IntegratePlayerVelocity
units.summary: Update decoded controls/velocity, then integrate signed velocities divided by eight into player coordinates, clamping at selected screen-edge thresholds.

units.name: Bank2_DecodeControlsAndAccelerate
units.summary: Choose normal/modified speed limits from held buttons, encode directional/action bits and update an action-hold counter. Apply horizontal acceleration/deceleration and vertical table-driven acceleration with signed limits.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateActionHoldCounter
units.summary: Count an encoded held action, preserve its release transition under state constraints and save the decoded input byte used by the action dispatcher.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: With no horizontal direction, approach zero by eight units. Otherwise accelerate left/right, with an alternate mode changing acceleration and cap at signed limits.

units.name: Bank2_UpdateVerticalVelocity
units.summary: Use directional bits to select acceleration; absent input damps by six units toward zero. Clamp to the same signed velocity bounds.

units.name: Bank2_AddAndClampPlayerAnchorX
units.summary: Add signed A to the player's aim anchor. The shifted comparison detects the upper wrap band and clamps it to $E8; the caller chooses a positive or negative movement entry.

units.name: Bank2_AdjustPlayerAimAnchor
units.summary: Add A to the player aim-anchor X and impose a minimum anchor threshold.

units.name: Bank2_ReturnFromInterruptStub
units.summary: This vector target returns immediately with RTI.

units.name: Bank2_SaveAndSwitchAxromServiceBank
units.summary: Push the caller's mapper shadow, retain its upper mode bits and combine Y's bank selector. Switch via ascending ROM bytes so bus conflicts preserve the value. The destination bank continues at the same CPU address with the shared directory resolver.

units.name: Bank2_ResolveAxromService
units.summary: Use X to select a word pointer from the current bank service directory, patch RAM01/02 and call RAM00 JMP. Restore the stacked mapper value and physical bank before RTS. Y supplies the destination bank to the shared prefix.

units.name: Bank2_NmiBankEntry
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y and select the NMI service bank while retaining mapper upper bits. The common tail then jumps to the service handler in its effective bank.

units.name: Bank2_ResetBankEntry
units.summary: Disable interrupts and decimal mode and select bank zero through the bus-safe table. The identical bank-zero continuation jumps to CPU8000.

units.name: Bank3_LoadEndingNametableStream
units.summary: Decode stream 8992 to PPU2000 with compressed count 00B8 through the bank-three signed-run decoder.

units.name: Bank3_LoadEndingOverlayStream
units.summary: Decode stream 8A4A to PPU2180 with count 000F. The small overlay shares the same stream pointer/count contract.

units.name: Bank3_LoadSceneCollisionRectangles
units.summary: Clear collision arrays, choose the scene's packed rectangle list and count, and expand each three-byte record into bounds and state. Apply additional stage-specific flags from sentinel-delimited tables.

units.name: Bank3_ExpandCollisionRectangle
units.summary: First two bytes hold start and extent nibbles for X/Y in two-cell units. The third splits mode and a count/state field; high mode values cause a larger count scale.

units.name: Bank3_ApplyStageRectangleFlags
units.summary: Encode level/scene in one byte and scan four table groups. Matching entries OR flag one into the selected rectangle field; $FF advances the group.

units.name: Bank3_LoadSceneGraphicStreams
units.summary: Select two scene-specific compressed streams and a fixed stream, assign their PPU destinations and decode them using this bank's bounded RLE copy.

units.name: Bank3_SetPpuDestination
units.summary: Write X as the high PPU address byte and Y as the low byte; caller has reset the PPU latch.

units.name: Bank3_LoadFixedPatternStream
units.summary: Initialize a fixed compressed stream and decode it at PPU pattern destination $1000.

units.name: Bank3_DecodePpuRle
units.summary: Copy signed literal/repeated runs into PPUDATA, consuming a bounded compressed input count. This bank's count helper has the same zero/borrow convention as bank two; output extent is not inferred as a source boundary.

units.name: Bank3_ReadPpuRleHeader
units.summary: Positive headers copy header+1 literals. Negative headers repeat the next byte for two's-complement(header)+1 writes.

units.name: Bank3_RepeatPpuRleByte
units.summary: Negate the signed control and emit one repeated byte before advancing input.

units.name: Bank3_AdvanceRleInput
units.summary: Advance the source pointer and decrement remaining compressed bytes. Return a nonzero stop value on high-byte underflow.

units.name: Bank3_InitializeSceneAnimationStream
units.summary: Use half the scene index to select an optional stream, load its first delay and reset two channel step counters to eight.

units.name: Bank3_UpdateSceneAnimation
units.summary: Skip absent streams or disabled actor work. Phase two advances delay/script tokens and tile-buffer animation; phase $10 may allocate an auxiliary object from selected channel states.

units.name: Bank3_SpawnAnimationAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Inspect two packed animation-channel states and find unused auxiliary slots. Initialize downward drops spaced by 32 pixels, with mode $FE, Y=$38, step three and target threshold $10. Preserve the channel selector through slot allocation.

units.name: Bank3_InitializeThreeAuxiliaryDrops
units.summary: Initialize each selected auxiliary slot with downward step three, negative mode $FE and a horizontally spaced start. Zero X step/extents/error, set Y=$38 and target threshold $10 before the shared loop continuation.

units.name: Bank3_AdvanceSceneAnimationToken
units.summary: Decrement the delay or consume a two-byte delay/state record. Split the state byte between two channels, initialize step counters and wrap the stream on a zero terminator.

units.name: Bank3_ApplySceneAnimationChannels
units.summary: For each channel resolve its packed direction/frame descriptor, optionally copy nonnegative bytes into the tile buffer at row stride 32, then advance its state by four.

units.name: Bank3_CopySceneAnimationColumn
units.summary: Convert a two-bit phase to a tile-buffer offset; negative source bytes skip writes and $FF terminates the column.

units.name: Bank3_FinishTwoPageRamCopy
units.summary: Advance destination X and source Y together until Y wraps, preserving the caller's page-copy setup.

units.name: Bank3_FinishSceneAnimationChannel
units.summary: After advancing the packed animation state by four, mask off its two selector bits and test terminal pattern $24. Clear the channel state at the terminal phase, then process the other channel. The following RTS byte also supplies lookup entry zero to the auxiliary-drop selector.

units.name: Bank3_BuildRankingNameEntryBackground
units.summary: Use the packed qualification nibbles to patch player-specific nametable attributes and select one of two text layouts. Build cursor sprites, expand all 256 byte patterns into two RAM planes and clear six name slots.

units.name: Bank3_PatchSparseEightByEightTiles
units.summary: Read sixty-four table bytes as eight rows. Nonzero bytes replace PPU tiles; zero entries consume a buffered PPU read to preserve that cell. Advance each row address by 32.

units.name: Bank3_BuildNameEntryGlyphResources
units.summary: Build two eight-sprite cursor blocks, then expand every byte value into paired bit-pattern planes by rotating each input bit into two output positions. The name renderer consumes these RAM planes; clear both three-byte name buffers afterward.

units.name: Bank3_BuildTwoColumnCursorSprites
units.summary: Scratch bytes supply base tile, X and Y; Y selects the OAM output offset. Emit four rows of two adjacent sprites, advancing tiles by one and screen Y by eight per row.

units.name: Bank3_UploadFirstPlayerReticlePatterns
units.summary: Write two selected 32-byte graphic blocks starting at CHR RAM $1000.

units.name: Bank3_UploadSecondPlayerReticlePatterns
units.summary: Write the analogous two blocks starting at CHR RAM $1040, selecting the second player's graphic-state pair.

units.name: Bank3_UploadReticlePatternBlock
units.summary: Multiply the selected graphic byte by 32 and copy exactly 32 bytes to PPUDATA while preserving Y.

units.name: Bank3_ReturnFromInterruptStub
units.summary: This vector target is an immediate RTI.

units.name: Bank3_SaveAndSwitchAxromServiceBank
units.summary: Push the caller mapper shadow, combine its upper mode with bank selector Y and switch through the common bus-safe table. Execution continues in the selected bank's shared service resolver.

units.name: Bank3_ResolveAxromService
units.summary: Use X to select a word pointer from the current bank service directory, patch RAM01/02 and call RAM00 JMP. Restore the stacked mapper value and physical bank before RTS. Y supplies the destination bank to the shared prefix.
